name: offline-pi
description: offline-pi: one offline app for a Raspberry Pi, a dashboard (core) and modules behind it

scripts.maps:setup: turbo run build --filter=@offline-pi/maps-shared && npm run -w @offline-pi/maps-backend setup
scripts.maps:assets:fetch: turbo run build --filter=@offline-pi/maps-shared && npm run -w @offline-pi/maps-backend assets:fetch
scripts.api:gen: npm run -w @offline-pi/core build && npm run -w @offline-pi/core openapi && npm run -w @offline-pi/api-client generate
